description: Plans a motorcycle route between two points in one country, with a choice of how winding the road should be, and returns the distance, the travel time and the main steps. It does not return a map, and riders must follow road signs.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example DE

curviness.description: 0 for the direct motorcycle route, 1 for a more winding one

lang.description: Optional language code for the reply, for example en

name: plan_curvy_route
title: Plan a curvy motorcycle route
